title: Hours taken in the Census Office's 1888 trial of tabulating methods, on 1880 returns from four districts of St. Louis
description: Bar chart, hours. Capturing the data: the two rival methods took 144.5 and 100.5 hours, Hollerith's punched cards 72.5 hours. Preparing it for tabulation: the rivals took 44.5 and 55.5 hours, Hollerith's machine 5.5 hours. Data: U.S. Census Bureau, The Hollerith Machine.
heading: 1888 TRIAL · HOURS, ST. LOUIS RETURNS
